method.tool: scratchpad/tools/coverage_search.py, --whole-words --regex, nine term sets (search/C7/terms.txt; outputs S1-baptism ... S8-saints-rites .json, all present and non-empty)
method.numbering: The saved runs used the earlier agent's own split (S1 baptism, S2 meal, S3 prayer, S4 gathering + S4b music/images/posture, S5 confession, S6 fasting, S7 calendar, S8 saints/rites). This report uses the fixed ids of repo/07-subquestions.yaml: C7.S1 baptism, S2 meal, S3 prayer, S4 worship, S5 confession and fasting, S6 calendar, S7 Mary/saints/anointing/weddings/funerals/unbaptised visitor, S8 apostolic origin. Earlier S5+S6 map to S5; earlier S7 maps to S6 and S8; earlier S8 maps to S7; the unbaptised visitor (C7-27) moved from S1 to S7.
method.record_check: independent read of front matter in records/<code>/ (recgrep.json, survey and topic scripts in search/C7/work/), then reading the key records in full; hits were judged on content, not counts
method.source_hits: each source_hits entry was found by regex in a file mapped to the world in cic/corpus-map/ and read in context; where the passage is an editor's note or a later redaction the note says so
method.verification: verify.py: quote text normalised and searched in the vendored file named by the source record; 90 quote records checked earlier (verify-all.json), 4 MISMATCH read by hand and found to be editorial artefacts (listed as MATCH (editorial artefact))
method.depth: full / partial / thin = how much of the sub-question the voice could answer from the world's own records today (a judgement from reading the records, not a count); LOADED cells are thin by definition
method.layers: RENDERED = a record speaks to the sub-question (star = true when only an honest_limit or guard answers; partial answers stay plain R and the note says what is missing); LOADED = vendored and mapped, read in context, no record; IDENTIFIED = registered, unvendored; OTHER = public-domain source outside the repo, named from working knowledge, not fetched; NOTHING.
method.lpc: All 330 lpc records are status: draft; counted as RENDERED with that caveat. lpc has no card.
method.not_read: canon/sealed_probes/ was not read; no model calls; no network.
